restaurantName: Cup Tea Lounge - Glasgow Merchant City
address: 43 Virginia Street, Unit 4, Virginia Court, Merchant City, Glasgow,G1 1TN
bio: Located in the thriving area of Merchant City, Cup Tea Lounge is the perfect place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city centre. Enjoy a leisurely Afternoon Tea in Cup Tea Lounge's courtyard.  Cup Tea Lounge offers a delicious Afternoon Tea including a selection of savoury bites, warm scones and an array of sweet treats. Why not upgrade your Afternoon Tea with a glass of prosecco, champagne or gin and tonic? Gluten Free and Vegetarian menus are also available.  Afternoon Tea is served in the main restaurant area, featuring beautiful wooden decor and hanging plants. Make the most of a sunny day and take your Afternoon Tea on the courtyard underneath cheerful bunting.  Cup Tea Lounge Glasgow Merchant City is located in Glasgow city centre and is within walking distance of Glasgow Central Station and Glasgow Queen Street Station.
pageTitle: Cup Tea Lounge - Glasgow Merchant City
